releaseNotes:
- Initial release of tiffy-click v1.0.0
- Windows-style Universal Autoscroll (Smart Hold + Toggle) with 4-way floating HUD across all macOS apps
- 3-finger Trackpad & Magic Mouse Middle-Click, Tap-to-Click, and full Middle-Drag support
- Smart AXUIElement detection so middle-clicking links and browser tabs still works naturally
- Native SwiftUI Settings window with Thai (th) & English (en) language support, Palm Rejection, and Per-App Ignore rules
